scope: Four uninterrupted outer boot prefixes execute the original MOVIE.BIN request without changing its name or manufacturing an I/O result. Directory metadata uses the extracted disc inventory. The actual read reaches the unresolved firmware vector with FAD 510488 and 91 sectors. Runtime driver/filesystem/directory/handle tables and prior peripheral snapshots remain explicit fixtures.
limitations: No physical disc bytes are transferred and no firmware completion, natural initialization, IRQ delivery or playable boot is claimed.
The parent file loader and outer boot remain partial. Existing native disc queue/sector-reader/service code is the next reusable platform dependency.
